lore: A trim that holds the light a moment longer than it should.
use: Lay down an armor trim template, hold 2 Glow Ink Sacs in the off hand and hit it 5 times with an axe (with SimpleBuilding: a sledgehammer); it also takes 4 diamonds and 2 glowstone. One template, 7 diamonds and a glowstone block make 2.
secret: At the smithing table, template, armor and a Glow Ink Sac make the trim glow steadily at full brightness. It only glows visually and gives off no real light.

lore: A trim that does not just shine, it lights the way for others.
use: Lay down an armor trim template, hold 2 Glowstone Dust in the off hand and hit it 5 times with an axe (with SimpleBuilding: a sledgehammer); it also takes 4 diamonds and 2 blaze powder. One template, 7 diamonds and a magma block make 2.
secret: At the smithing table, with Glowstone Dust, armor becomes a wearable light source: an invisible light block follows your head. More dust raises the radiance, up to level 5.

lore: A trim with a heartbeat of its own.
use: Craft 2 echo shards, 2 sculk, 4 diamonds and an axe (with SimpleBuilding: a sledgehammer); the tool stays in the grid and loses 1 durability. One template, 7 diamonds and a sculk block make 2.
secret: At the smithing table, template, armor and an Echo Shard make the trim pulse from full color to gray every 2.4 seconds. Together with Glowing, the brightness pulses too.

lore: A book that keeps the shine of every trim on record.
use: The Simple Trims Guide explains the three trim templates, placing templates and forging them. Craft it shapeless from a book and a Glow Ink Sac.
secret: The pages follow your language and update with the mod, even in old copies of the book.

lore: A template laid down like a note on the table.
use: Sneak and use an armor trim template on a floor, wall or ceiling. Breaking it gives back exactly that template, name included.
secret: With the template tool in the main hand and Glow Ink or Glowstone Dust in the off hand, right clicks forge it instead of breaking it.
